info.name: SMemories - book as plain text
info.description: Book export as text (T-093, D-32): `GET /api/book-export/get-text?yearbook_id=&lang=` and the public photo link inside it. `{status,data}` envelope, `ERROR_*` codes. Uses the three fixed accounts of notes.postman_collection.json: run that collection's Setup once (or this one's Setup) and then `make verify-newman-users`, so A and B are verified and C is not. Run from the repository root: `newman run postman/book-export.postman_collection.json --working-dir postman` (one note uploads fixtures/media/photo-gps.jpg). Start the API with SMEM_ENV=dev and the `make up` stack; the text links start with SMEM_PUBLIC_BASE_URL, but the requests that open them use `baseUrl`. The Full flow creates and deletes its own yearbook, so the collection can run twice in a row; a run makes 4 public submissions (limit 100 per IP per hour), about 10 export calls (limit 30 per 10 minutes per user) and one revoke (limit 10 per hour); `make reset-limits` clears the limits.

item.name: 11. A approves N2 then N1 (book order N2, N1)
12. English text: approved notes only, in book order, one photo link, nothing internal

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); const d = j.data;
pm.test('book order, N2 first', () => { const a = d.text.indexOf('Lê Thị Hoà'), b = d.text.indexOf('Trần Văn Ngô'); pm.expect(a).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(b).to.be.above(a); });

pm.test('long answer on its own indented lines', () => pm.expect(d.text).to.include('Your message:
  Dòng một

  Dòng ba 🎉
'));
pm.test('hidden and pending notes are not in the text', () => { pm.expect(d.text).to.not.include('HiddenFriend'); pm.expect(d.text).to.not.include('PendingFriend'); });

pm.test('nothing internal', () => { const raw = pm.response.text(); [pm.collectionVariables.get('bookId'), pm.collectionVariables.get('n1'), pm.collectionVariables.get('n2'), pm.collectionVariables.get('emailA')].forEach(v => pm.expect(raw).to.not.include(v)); pm.expect(d.text).to.not.include('@'); });
pm.test('one photo link, a token', () => { pm.expect(links.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(links[0][1]).to.match(/^[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$/); });
pm.test('Photo 1 label under N2', () => pm.expect(d.text).to.match(/Photo 1: https?:\/\/\S+\n/));
